fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at any driveway. Street View (Dec 2024) along the full Maddox-Simpson Pkwy frontage from multiple headings shows open driveways onto the industrial-park loop road with no control structure. Site is an open campus typical of a small-town industrial park.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. The brick building with garage bays seen in Street View on the south access road is a separate maintenance/shop building, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: L-shaped two-building white-roof DC plus a separate maintenance/canopy shop building in the yard; counted as a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage lot on the west side (full of parked trailers) plus a second separate trailer lot to the southeast across the loop road.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved yard between the buildings provides ample queuing/holding space before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single-lane open driveways; no formal multi-lane gate to count — estimate 1 in / 1 out.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not adjacent.
